component.title: SearchFilterResults
component.purpose: Keep query intent, asynchronous result state, and the distinction between an empty collection and no matches visible in one responsive surface.

states.description: A query surface and populated result list are available.
The query has no matches and can be relaxed without confusing it with an empty source.
The source contains no results yet and communicates a different next step.
The request fails while the query remains visible and retryable.

elements.description: The preserved query and filter form.

claims.statement: The search form remains present while result state changes.
No matches and no indexed results use distinct headings and guidance.
The request-error state exposes a named retry action.
